title: RPG Maker MZ 's sprites look blurry when scaled up!

posts.author: SamXID
posts.body:
Hi. i am running the 20 day free trial version of RPG Maker MZ on windows, and i have run into a problem: My sprites look blurry!
Here are my settings in system 2:
they are set up this way because i am porting over some graphics i made for a game in wolfRPG editor (I'm trying to port the whole game over to RPG maker MZ, but that's besides the point), and i don't feel like making them from scratch, so i am trying to get them to run as 1:1 as possible, hence the strangely small resolution, this however, seems to cause the game to blur things for some reason.
I understand this is because of how image scaling works and such, but i was wondering if there was a way for me to change it to "nearest pixel", like in most editing softwares, so i don't have to worry about the blurriness anymore. Does anyone know of such a way to accomplish that? thanks.
